summary: Reproduced the reported per-line oversell. With WIDGET stock 10 on one server, a cart with 5 OVS-PIECE raced against a cart with 3 OVS-PIECE plus 2 OVS-TWOPACK (4 units) produced two orders in 6 of 13 runs, and WIDGET reserved reached 12 of 10 stock, failing no_oversell. The source confirms the cause: ensureInventoryLevels (validateQuantityAtLocation loop, inventory-module.ts ~lines 173-191) checks each reservation input alone against available_quantity and never sums inputs sharing an inventory item and location. I did not test the second-process lost-update part of the report (stale-counter-write), so I am not claiming it.
